title: Airgap service-account profiles and Helm identity-to-service-account mapping
author: Kira Patel
release_notes: Adds configurable service-account profiles for airgap/private deployments and a Helm values mapping to bind chart identities to explicit service accounts. Helps installers avoid in-cluster RBAC bootstrapping and simplifies offline upgrades.
description:
Motivation: In air-gapped and restricted VPC/on-prem installs customers often need explicit control over service accounts, token provisioning, and RBAC bindings because automated in-cluster account bootstrap is disallowed by security policy. This PR introduces a deterministic mapping layer between Helm chart identities (what charts expect as runtime identity) and pre-provisioned Kubernetes ServiceAccounts, plus a 'sa profiles' concept for airgap installer bundles so operators can bake permissions and KMS annotations into the bundle.

What this PR does (single-string body): Adds a Helm values schema extension `identity.serviceAccountMapping` to map logical identities used by charts to concrete ServiceAccount names and namespaces; implements `installer/sa-profiles/` bundle metadata (YAML) that the airgap installer reads at preflight; updates the Terraform registry-seed module to produce a minimal ServiceAccount manifest and imagePullSecret references when using 'preseeded' mode; and adds upgrade/rollback hooks that validate SA mappings before switching to a new runtime. Includes a migration helper script `bin/sa-migrate` for clusters using the old automatic-bootstrap mode.

Implementation details and commits summary: - commit a1f4d2c: initial Helm values schema and templating for identity mapping (charts/redwood-core/values.schema.json, charts/_helpers.tpl) - commit b3e9fc7: installer: add sa-profiles directory + schema and validation helpers (installer/sa-profiles/*) - commit c5d11ab: terraform: registry-seed module extension to emit sa manifests and attach imagePullSecrets in preseed mode (terraform/modules/registry-seed) - commit d004b9f: add upgrade hook logic: preflight check for missing SAs and drift detection (installer/upgrades/preflight-sa-check.go) - commit e77b9b2: add integration e2e-airgap test and fixture (tests/e2e/airgap/sa-profile-fixture.yaml, tests/e2e/airgap/test_sa_profiles.go) - commit f11d8c0: docs and examples (docs/airgap/sa-profiles.md, examples/airgap/sa-profile-example.yaml)

Files of note changed: charts/redwood-core/values.schema.json, charts/redwood-core/templates/identity-serviceaccount.tpl, installer/sa-profiles/README.md, installer/sa-profiles/example-profile.yaml, installer/upgrades/preflight-sa-check.go, terraform/modules/registry-seed/main.tf, tests/e2e/airgap/test_sa_profiles.go, bin/sa-migrate, docs/airgap/sa-profiles.md.

How to test locally (airgapped flow): 1) Build a sealed bundle: `make bundle AIRGAP=true SA_PROFILE=examples/sa-profile-example.yaml` 2) Seed a local OCI mirror with the bundle tar and start `kind` cluster with airgap network rules. 3) Run `terraform apply` with the registry-seed module in `preseed` mode to create the service accounts and imagePullSecrets. 4) Install the chart with `--set identity.serviceAccountMapping.redwood=redwood-sa` and run the preflight: `./installer/bin/preflight --check-sa-mapping`. 5) Run tests: `go test ./tests/e2e/airgap -run TestSAProfiles -v`.

Backwards compatibility and migration: The old behavior (installer auto-creates SAs) remains available when `sa_profile` is omitted. The `bin/sa-migrate` helper will create canonical SAs in the expected namespace and annotate them for KMS/secrets as needed. Migration steps are documented in docs/airgap/sa-profiles.md.

Security considerations: The PR avoids creating tokens during install in airgapped mode; imagePullSecrets and KMS annotations are only referenced, not emitted with cleartext secrets. The Terraform changes add an optional `preseed_create_sa` boolean (default false) to avoid accidental SA creation.

Review conversation (high-level): - Diego Alvarez (reviewer): "Can we make the mapping schema tolerant to missing namespaces and default to chart namespace? Also please add unit tests for templating edge cases." -- Author reply (Kira): "Good point — added fallback to chart namespace when namespace omitted and added templating unit tests in charts/tests/identity_mapping_test.go." - Morgan Chen: "Terraform module needs input validation for preseed mode to ensure imagePullSecrets exist." -- Author: "Added validation and a preseed plan-hook that fails fast if referenced secrets are missing." - Priya Rao: "Upgrade hook might race with kubelet image pulls in some constrained clusters — include retry/backoff and a clear operator-facing error." -- Author: "Implemented exponential backoff and explicit operator guidance in the error text. Also added an alert rule in observability pack to catch SA drift during rollout."
